title: Dauntless Companion
about: Health bars for the behemoths you hit, with stagger, enrage and aethercharge indicators. Hunt Stats tracks lifetime stats per weapon type. Build Search finds armor sets for your perks. Save, share and pin builds. Play in borderless or windowed mode.
keys: Show or hide the health bars
Clear the active health bars and the pinned build
Preview mode (move, resize and test animations)
Move the bars while in preview mode (Ctrl+Alt+Home resets)
Resize the bars while in preview mode (Ctrl+Shift+Home resets)
